description: Four secondary-electron SEM micrographs of tensile fracture surfaces of a low-density δ-TRIP steel plate annealed at increasing temperature; the caption assigns (a) OA-620, (b) OA-680, (c) OA-740 and (d) OA-800, whereas the citing text calls the same specimens QA-620 to QA-800. Each panel carries a 50 µm scale bar; (a) and (c) additionally contain insets with 5 µm scale bars. Colour coding stated in the caption: red dashed = cleavage, blue dashed = quasi-cleavage, yellow dashed = small dimples, red arrows = laminar tears, yellow arrows = large dimples; white arrows label river pattern, cleavage step and second cracks. (a) shows a broad yellow-outlined dimple field next to red-outlined cleavage with cleavage step and river pattern, a white-arrowed second crack, red laminar-tear arrows, and an inset of quasi-cleavage plus dimples. (b) shows crisscrossing blue quasi-cleavage, yellow dimples and a red river-pattern cleavage band, with red laminar-tear arrows and a yellow-arrowed large dimple. (c) shows two second cracks, blue quasi-cleavage, and an inset with dimples and cleavage step. (d) is layered: quasi-cleavage at top, then a dimple band, then a cleavage layer with cleavage step and a second crack at the bottom.
measured_quantities: annealing temperature (°C, encoded in sample labels OA-620/OA-680/OA-740/OA-800)

observations.observation: The figure comprises four SEM micrographs of tensile fracture surfaces, each with a 50 µm scale bar; panels (a) and (c) contain additional insets with 5 µm scale bars.
Panel (a) contains printed labels 'cleavage', 'cleavage step' (white arrow), 'river pattern' (white arrow), 'dimples' (yellow outline) and 'second crack' (white arrow).
Panel (b) contains printed labels 'quasi-cleavage' (blue dashed), 'dimples' (yellow outline), 'river pattern' (white arrow) and 'second crack' (white arrow).
Panels (c) and (d) both contain two separate white-arrowed 'second crack' annotations.

Panel (d) displays layered/banded morphology in which a yellow-outlined 'dimples' band separates a blue-dashed 'quasi-cleavage' region at the top from a red-dashed 'cleavage' band with 'cleavage step' below.

The caption states the colour code: red dashed areas are cleavage, blue dashed areas are quasi-cleavage, yellow dashed areas are small dimples, red arrows point at laminar tears and yellow arrows point at large dimples.
The caption assigns the panels to OA-620, OA-680, OA-740 and OA-800, i.e. an annealing-temperature series.
The citing text labels the same specimens QA-620, QA-680, QA-740 and QA-800, a different prefix from the caption's 'OA-', so the sample naming is inconsistent between caption and body text.
The citing text states that for QA-620 (panel a) significantly smaller micro-dimples than in the other specimens were observed.

The citing text states that in QA-680 and QA-740 (panels b and c) the cleavage/quasi-cleavage and dimple areas have no sensible borders and crisscross together, with larger dimples (yellow arrows) present in addition to the normal agglomerated dimples of the yellow dashed regions.
The citing text states that in QA-800 (panel d) the cleavage layer mainly shows cleavage steps alternating with a dimples layer, matching the banded appearance visible in that panel.
The citing text attributes cleavage features (river pattern, cleavage step, marked by white arrows) to δ-ferrite and states that second cracks arise from stress concentration at δ/γ-α interfaces.
All four fracture surfaces show a mixed fracture mode combining cleavage, quasi-cleavage and dimple regions rather than a single failure mechanism.
No numeric property values (stress, strain, temperature) are printed on any panel; the only quantitative markings are the 50 µm and 5 µm scale bars.

subfigures.description: SEM fracture surface (OA-620) with 50 µm scale bar. Red dashed region labelled 'cleavage' and 'cleavage step' (white arrow), a red-dashed band with 'river pattern' (white arrow), a large yellow-outlined 'dimples' field, a white-arrowed 'second crack', and red arrows for laminar tears.
Enlarged inset (5 µm scale bar) of a fracture region labelled 'quasi-cleavage' (upper area) and 'dimples' (lower area).

SEM fracture surface (OA-680) with 50 µm scale bar. Blue dashed 'quasi-cleavage', yellow-outlined 'dimples', a red dashed region with 'river pattern' (white arrow), a white-arrowed 'second crack', red arrows pointing at laminar tears and a yellow arrow pointing at a large dimple.

SEM fracture surface (OA-740) with 50 µm scale bar. Two white-arrowed 'second crack' features, blue dashed 'quasi-cleavage', yellow dashed dimple field, and red/yellow arrows on tear and dimple features.
Enlarged inset (5 µm scale bar) with a yellow dashed 'dimples' field and a red dashed area labelled 'cleavage step' (white arrow).

SEM fracture surface (OA-800) with 50 µm scale bar, showing stacked layers: blue dashed 'quasi-cleavage' at the top, a yellow dashed 'dimples' band, a red dashed 'cleavage' band with 'cleavage step' (white arrow), and a bottom white-arrowed 'second crack'.

unreadable_items: Precise targets of the small red arrows (laminar tears) in panels (a)-(c) are only approximately locatable where they fall in unlabelled areas
The caption spells 'yellow' as 'vellow', an obvious typographical error
